checks: Month boundaries, leap years and weekday identity remain timezone independent
Schedules, exclusions and active dates count expected archive receipts only
Pending, reference, suspected reference and Monthly files cannot supply Daily receipt
Future dates stay neutral and do not increase receipt or missing counts
Off-schedule saved reports stay visible without creating an expected test
Calendar selection isolates scanners and rejects unknown or invalid dates
Duplicate records do not multiply report links and the snapshot stays unchanged
scope: Pure cached metadata calendar rules. Does not read PDFs, contact scanners or establish clinical test completion.
